cause_quote: The original dashboard title code passed `maxLength: DASHBOARD_SESSION_TITLE_MAX_CHARS` before normalization and selected the first nonblank, non-fence line with `.find((line) => line && !line.startsWith("```"))`, so an explanation ahead of the title was saved as the title.
user_saw: An automatically named chat could show a clipped model explanation or a prefix such as “Session title:” in its name.
summary: The gateway now extracts the title from the full model response, strips recognized title prefixes, and applies the length limit afterward.
reasoning: The introducing diff shows that the dashboard feature capped the model response before normalization, picked the first eligible line, and stripped only a bare English `Title:` prefix. I checked the later Haiku routing change, which changed the model and runtime without changing title extraction, and the fix PR reproduced the same failure with controlled Ollama responses.
